name: Demetrius (silversmith in Ephesus)
title: The Silversmith Who Stirred Up a Riot
summary: Demetrius was a silversmith in Ephesus who made silver shrines of the goddess Artemis. He feared that the apostle Paul's preaching would ruin their trade and the worship of Artemis, so he organized a riot against the Christians in the city.

keyEvents.title: Organizing the Craftsmen
keyEvents.description: Demetrius gathered the silversmiths and other craftsmen who made shrines of Artemis, warning them that Paul's preaching threatened their livelihood and the honor of the goddess Artemis.

keyEvents.title: Starting the Riot in Ephesus
keyEvents.description: Demetrius' speech stirred up anger among the craftsmen, and they began shouting, 'Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!' This led to a chaotic riot in the city.

keyEvents.title: The Riot at the Theater
keyEvents.description: The crowd rushed into the great theater in Ephesus and seized Paul's traveling companions Gaius and Aristarchus. The confusion was so great that most did not know why they had gathered.

keyEvents.title: The City Clerk Calms the Riot
keyEvents.description: The city clerk of Ephesus calmed the crowd and warned them that the Romans could accuse them of rioting. He urged Demetrius to use the legal courts if he had any complaints.
